title: Bubbles of Gothic Reverie
description: A surreal gothic scene featuring multiple stylized anime-style girls in black and pink frilled dresses floating inside large iridescent soap bubbles. The background consists of abstract orange and red geometric panels with faint gothic architectural arches against a dark teal backdrop. Thin glowing lines and sparkles connect the floating bubbles.
